verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a key-authenticated API and a DisputesAPI for building custom dispute management, so an agent could plausibly handle the dispute part through a documented programmatic surface. Payouts are only documented as a Dashboard view, and balances are not covered at all. missing for 10: documented API access to balances and payouts, payout-investigation workflows, dispute evidence submission details, agent-specific surfaces (MCP/agent tooling), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the money side — read balances and payouts, investigate a seller's missing payout, draft dispute evidence — against documented, agent-usable surfaces

citations.quote: a custom dispute management experience can be built using the DisputesAPI.
API keys are required to access API.
